companions.name: Combat drone
companions.provisional_note: HP 30, the service pistol, shoot only and infinite ammo are settled (Leon, 7 Nov 2026; spec 14 item 370). Defense, attack bonus, armour and Movement stay provisional.
companions.text: A Drone Handler's drone: it acts right after its owner, on the owner's orders: it moves and it shoots, nothing else (no aimed shot, burst, Overwatch, reload or jam clearing). Its service pistol never runs dry: no reloads, no Heat, no jams. At 0 HP it is destroyed, not Downed; Field Repair or a workshop brings it back.

companions.name: Beast companion
companions.provisional_note: HP 60 is settled (Leon, 7 Nov 2026; spec 14 item 370). Defense, attack bonus, armour and Movement stay provisional.
companions.text: A Beast Handler's animal: it acts right after its owner, on the owner's orders. At 0 HP it is out (destroyed for the fight); rest and care bring it back.

companions.name: the twin
companions.text: A Twinbound's twin, called on the area map: a token with its own 4 AP a round, spent only on moves, never more than 6 tiles from its owner. HP half its owner's maximum and its owner's Defense (the numbers here are stand-ins the engine replaces). A fight opened on the area map starts with it beside its owner as the called twin.
